record.paper_title: Dima Khavinson’s 60th: a summary of open problems in analysis and mathematical physics
record.original_question: Let Γ be a real-analytic nonsingular hypersurface in R^n, and let u_Γ be its modified Schwarz potential, meaning a solution near Γ of Δu_Γ = 1 together with u_Γ = 0 and ∇u_Γ = 0 on Γ. If u_Γ extends to an entire real-analytic function on all of R^n, must Γ necessarily be a plane?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 1.1 (1) If u is an entire real-analytic function in R^n, then Γ must be a plane.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n \ge 2$ and let $\Gamma \subset \mathbb{R}^n$ be a real-analytic, nonsingular (i.e. smoothly embedded codimension-one) hypersurface. By the Cauchy–Kovalevskaya theorem there exists, in some open neighborhood $U$ of $\Gamma$, a unique real-analytic function $u_\Gamma : U \to \mathbb{R}$, called the modified Schwarz potential of $\Gamma$, satisfying
\[
\Delta u_\Gamma = 1 \text{ in } U, \qquad u_\Gamma = 0 \text{ on } \Gamma, \qquad \nabla u_\Gamma = 0 \text{ on } \Gamma,
\]
where $\Delta$ is the Euclidean Laplacian.

Suppose that $u_\Gamma$ extends to a real-analytic function defined on all of $\mathbb{R}^n$ (i.e. it is entire real-analytic). Prove or disprove: $\Gamma$ must be an affine hyperplane in $\mathbb{R}^n$.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is a conjecture associated with D. Khavinson and H. S. Shapiro concerning rigidity of the (modified) Schwarz potential. Available surveys and papers (e.g. on Laplacian/elliptic growth and singularities of the Schwarz potential) state that the conjecture is easy in the plane (n=2) but remains open in higher dimensions. No proof in general dimension is reported.

status_evidence.title: Laplacian growth, elliptic growth, and singularities of the Schwarz potential
status_evidence.snippet: Discussion of the Schwarz potential conjecture, noted to be true in the plane but unresolved in higher dimensions.
status_evidence.claim: The Schwarz-potential rigidity conjecture is known in dimension 2 and remains open in higher dimensions.

status_evidence.title: Linear Holomorphic Partial Differential Equations and Classical Potential Theory (AMS Surveys 232)
status_evidence.snippet: Monograph treating the Khavinson–Shapiro circle of conjectures on the Schwarz potential and entire solutions of Cauchy problems.
status_evidence.claim: Standard reference compiling the Khavinson–Shapiro conjectures on Schwarz potentials; rigidity to a plane in R^n is listed as open.
